name: omniroute

full.label: omniroute (full dashboard)
full.description: DO NOT BUILD ON TERMUX. The Next.js dashboard compile asks for a 2GB heap and then swap-thrashes a 7GB phone until the kernel OOM-killer fires; it wedges the device rather than failing. recipes/omniroute-termux.sh hard-refuses this variant on-device unless OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_FULL_ON_DEVICE=1 is set explicitly. Cross-build on the VPS instead (recipes/vps/build-omniroute.sh), then rsync dist/ + app/ across.

lite.label: omniroute-lite (CLI/API only)
lite.description: OMNIROUTE_BUILD_BACKEND_ONLY=1: full backend API + inference plane, dashboard stubbed. ~40% smaller, builds with ~1.5GB heap. Recommended for Termux on-device builds.

source.notes: npm package is precompiled x64/glibc — on aarch64/Termux the ONLY viable path is source build. Termux-native patches required: (1) better-sqlite3 must be compiled from source (node -p process.platform = 'android', prebuilds never match); (2) node-machine-id needs android case + persistent $HOME/.omniroute/machine-id; (3) /v1/models visibility patch re-applied post-build.

notes: Server: omniroute serve --no-open. Port 20128. Endpoints: /api/health, /v1/models, /v1/chat/completions. Base-URL intercept for harnesses: OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1
